image: Bandeira do estado de São Paulo.svg
name: São Paulo
summary: Thirteen black and white horizontal stripes with a red canton holding a white disc with a blue map of Brazil and four yellow stars in its corners.
origin: Júlio Ribeiro designed it in 1888 as a proposed national flag for the coming Republic. Rejected nationally in 1889, it became the symbol of São Paulo after the 1932 Constitutionalist Revolution and was adopted officially in 1946.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: Black Brazilians; the nights of the bandeirantes' struggles.

symbols.name: Map of Brazil
symbols.description: A blue outline in a white disc.
symbols.meaning: Brazil; the flag was first proposed for the whole country.

symbols.name: Four stars
symbols.description: Yellow stars at the canton's corners.

facts: It flew over the governor's palace on 15 November 1889, four days before Brazil adopted its current flag.
Its three main colours echo von Martius's 'three races' theory.
clues: Thirteen black and white stripes with a red canton showing a map of Brazil.
It was proposed as the national flag in 1888.
The flag of Brazil's most populous state.
